Author: Serpens66
Name: Active AIV Detector
Description: Diagnostic mod that logs the lord and AIVJSON selected by the native castle placement engine.

Changes: Bundle all vanilla AIVJSON files from the official Castle and CPU Lord Editor.
Report the concrete bundled vanilla AIVJSON path and SHA-256 while distinguishing it from the embedded data actually used by the game.
Report the concrete bundled vanilla lordjson corresponding to an embedded default AIC.
Verify bundled vanilla AIC exports against the installed CrusaderDE.dll SHA-256 and distinguish equivalent exports from files actually read by the game.
Distinguish the logical base lord from temporary SK_X1 through SK_X8 runtime slots.
Report the selected custom lordjson path and checksum when an Extended Lord configuration is active.
Use the runtime AILords enum's Int32 backing type when validating captured lord IDs.
Keep reporting finalized selections even if source metadata resolution fails for one player.
Capture the lobby lord and AIV source list before a skirmish starts.
Resolve the native candidate ID to custom AIV names and paths or equivalent vanilla editor filenames.
Report effective Script Extender AIV asset overrides when present.
Buffer final native AIV selections until OnStartMap(Post) confirms the map has fully started.
Report selections only for active AI player slots and use Info logging for normal diagnostics.
Detect the final native AIV selection for every AI player.
Log candidate ID, orientation, placement result, AI type, and AIVSpec index with millisecond timestamps.
